tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a local image file (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) to Sanity as an image asset. Returns the asset ID, CDN URL, and an image `reference` object ready to set on any image field.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file

alt.description: Alt text (derived from filename if omitted)

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

tools.name: upload_and_set
tools.description: Upload a local image and set it on a field of an existing Sanity document in one call. Overwrites the current value of that field. Use groq_query first to find the document ID. The document is checked before uploading, so a wrong ID uploads nothing. The given ID is patched exactly as written (use `drafts.<id>` to patch a draft). A bare ID that has only ever existed as a draft patches `drafts.<id>`. If you patch a published document that also has a draft, the response includes a `note` saying so.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file

documentId.description: Sanity document ID to patch: a published ID, or `drafts.<id>` to patch the draft

fieldPath.description: Path to the image field, dot-separated for nested objects (e.g. 'hero.image')

alt.description: Alt text (derived from filename if omitted)

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

tools.name: batch_upload
tools.description: Upload every image (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) in a local folder as Sanity assets. Does not patch any documents. Files that fail are reported in `failed` while the rest still upload. Returns asset IDs, URLs and ready-to-use image references.

directory.description: Path to the folder with images

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List image files (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) in a local directory with their sizes, so you can see what is available to upload. Does not contact Sanity.

directory.description: Path to the directory to list

tools.name: groq_query
tools.description: Run a read-only GROQ query against the Sanity dataset and return the result as JSON. Useful to find document IDs and field names before upload_and_set. Uses the `raw` perspective by default, so drafts are included and every `_id` is the real stored ID (`drafts.`-prefixed for drafts) that upload_and_set can patch. Filter drafts out with `!(_id in path("drafts.**"))` or pass perspective `published`.

perspective.description: Which documents the query sees (default: 'raw'). 'raw': published documents and drafts side by side, with real IDs. 'published': published documents only, no drafts. 'drafts': as if every draft were published; drafts replace their published document, and `_id` shows the published ID even for never-published drafts (the stored ID is in `_originalId`).

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')
